stakingQueryCompatibility.scope: Every pinned value for all five named prefixes, decoded independently with deployed and candidate PolkadotJS registries; exact JSON equality and full SCALE roundtrip.

memoryCompatibility.sourceContext: Current host source adds configured extra pages to module minimum. This is source context; exact candidate instantiation is exercised separately by local Wasm rehearsals.

exportCompatibility.reason: Only removal of the linker global __data_end is permitted. Neither inspected Wasmtime nor Chopsticks host reads it; both require __heap_base, which is preserved. Runtime functions, their signatures and all other named exports remain exact. Actual host instantiation is required in the subsequent local rehearsals.

limitations: Metadata comparison covers declared SCALE layouts, indices, storage hashers/defaults and signed extensions; it does not execute migrations or prove custom codec behavior.
Host-interface checks preserve named imports and signatures. Import/export ordering is compiler-internal and is recorded rather than treated as an ABI.
Imported memory minimum changes satisfy the current default static strategy and wasm32 address-space bound; actual candidate host instantiation must pass separately in local rehearsals.
No governance calls are encoded, signed or submitted. Subwasm authorize-upgrade call hashes are not used.
